L3Harris Technologies is hiring an Associate, Multimedia Web Developer/Programmer to develop interactive training experiences and responsive learning tools for end-user tactical radio products. The role also creates internal web applications and programmatic algorithms to support the training department, collaborating with visual and instructional designers.

Preferred
JavaScript (both legacy (ES5) and modern standards (ES6+)), HTML5, CSS3, SQL/Database experience
Experience with jQuery, CreateJS/ZIMjs, ElectronJS, ASP.NET Core, C#, Razor Pages, Adobe Creative Cloud, Unreal Engine a plus
Capability to read, debug, and explain code for both technical and non-technical individuals
Ability to implement or collaborate on graphic and UI/UX design elements
Benefits
9/80 schedule: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked, and have every other Friday off
Health and disability insurance; 401(k) match; flexible spending accounts; EAP; education assistance; parental leave; paid time off; and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.
